20261121-physics-e4-2.title: Marka musmaar si adag ugu dhex
20261121-physics-e4-2.topic: Marka musmaar si adag ugu dhex
20261121-physics-e4-2.goal: Apply principles of Marka musmaar si adag ugu dhex to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-e4-2.material: Marka musmaar si adag ugu dhex dhex ah looxda lagu soo saarayo dubbe, haddii gacanta lagu qabto dhamaadka gacanta dubbaha ma aha bartamaha, xoog aad uga yar ayaa loo baahan yahay. Waa maxay sababta cilmiga?

20261122-physics-e4-1.material: [Fikirka sare] Marka lever la isticmaalayo si dhagax culus loo kor qaado, haddii barta taageerada la dhigo dhagaxa (barta shaqada) u dhow, xoogga gacanta ee loo baahan yahay wuu yaraadaa, laakiin masaafada gacantu hoos u dhaqaaqayso sidee ayay isu beddelaysaa?
